items.name: avatar-001
items.title: Аватар с фото
items.description: Базовый аватар: фотография, точка присутствия и три размера. Нет фотографии — остаются инициалы на фоне, выведенном из имени.
items.docs: Компонент самодостаточен: один файл, без зависимостей, собственная палитра в локальных переменных --vibeui-avatar-001-*. Фотография подставляется пропом src обычным с object-fit: cover — компонент переносим и не зависит от next/image. Без фотографии показываются инициалы, а оттенок фона считается из имени детерминированной функцией hueOf и подставляется в переменную --vibeui-avatar-001-hue: фон и цвет букв выводятся из неё через oklch, поэтому контраст держится на любом оттенке. Полное имя лежит скрытым текстом для скринридера, инициалы помечены aria-hidden. Тема берётся из color-scheme через light-dark(), классовую тёмную тему компонент включает себе сам.

en.title: Photo Avatar
en.docs: The component is self-contained: one file, no dependencies, its own palette in the local --vibeui-avatar-001-* variables. The photo is supplied through the src prop as a plain with object-fit: cover — the component is portable and does not depend on next/image. Without a photo the initials are shown, and the background hue is computed from the name by the deterministic hueOf function and fed into the --vibeui-avatar-001-hue variable: the background and the letter colour are derived from it through oklch, so contrast holds at any hue. The full name lies in hidden text for a screen reader, and the initials are marked aria-hidden. The theme comes from color-scheme through light-dark(), and the component switches the class-based dark theme on for itself.

en.title: Photo Fallback
en.docs: The component is self-contained: one file, no dependencies, its own palette in the local --vibeui-avatar-002-* variables. Server-side: there are no hooks. The initials lie underneath as an absolutely positioned backdrop and the photo is a layer on top with alt="", so a failed load leaves the backdrop rather than a broken-image icon. The name is exposed as a hidden line for a screen reader. The size is set by a single variable, --vibeui-avatar-002-size, and three ready-made values are selected by the data-size attribute. The theme comes from the surrounding color-scheme through light-dark(): the dark branch is not an inversion of the light one — the circle fill, the rings and the statuses each have their own pair of lightnesses.

en.title: Avatar Stack
en.docs: The component is self-contained: one file, no dependencies, its own palette in the local --vibeui-avatar-003-* variables. The markup is a ul/li list: the overlap comes from a negative margin, so the stack's width is honest, and the layering order is set by the --vibeui-avatar-003-z variable and is not limited by the number of participants. With tooltip on, the circle becomes a button, enters the tab order and gets :focus-visible, while the label lies inside the button as ordinary text and is revealed by :hover and :focus-visible rules — with no state and no JS. The names of the folded participants stay in the markup as hidden text. The theme comes from color-scheme through light-dark(), and the component switches the class-based dark theme on for itself.

en.docs: The component is self-contained: one file, no dependencies, its own palette in the local --vibeui-avatar-037-* variables. The identifier is folded into FNV-1a — the same hash as in the rest of the category's avatars, so a person's hue matches everywhere. From the hash a 5×5 grid is computed: the three left-hand columns are taken from the bits and the two right-hand ones mirror them, because a symmetric figure reads as a mark while an asymmetric one reads as noise. It is drawn as inline SVG in a 0 0 5 5 viewBox, with no images and no requests. The name lies in hidden text for a screen reader, and the pattern is marked aria-hidden. The theme comes from color-scheme through light-dark(), and the component switches the class-based dark theme on for itself.

items.name: avatar-039
items.title: Шапка профиля
items.description: Шапка страницы человека: обложка, крупный портрет внахлёст, имя, действие и счётчики одной раскладкой.

Портрет наезжает на обложку отрицательным margin, а не абсолютным позиционированием: высота шапки считается сама, и текст под портретом не приходится отодвигать вручную. Обложка нарисована градиентами, чтобы компонент выглядел готовым без картинки. Раскладка идёт от ширины самой шапки через container-type: inline-size — в узкой колонке она вертикальная, от 30rem имя и кнопка встают в строку. Оттенок обложки и портрета считается из имени тем же FNV-1a, что и у остальных аватаров категории. Тема приходит из color-scheme через light-dark(), классовую тёмную тему компонент включает себе сам.

items.name: avatar-040
items.title: Аватар с наклоном
items.description: Карточка портрета, которая разворачивается в объёме за курсором: слои разъезжаются параллаксом, следом идёт блик. На тач — по удержанию пальца.
items.docs: Клиентский компонент: наклон считается от положения курсора внутри карточки и водится CSS-переменными rx/ry, а не инлайновым transform. Слои — снимок, штора, блик, подпись, метка — разнесены по глубине через translateZ на общей сцене с perspective и transform-style: preserve-3d, поэтому при наклоне разъезжаются параллаксом. Поток pointermove гасится через requestAnimationFrame: за кадр применяется последнее положение. Блик — радиальный градиент в режиме soft-light, его центр gx/gy идёт за указателем, а прозрачность снимается при уходе. Тема берётся из color-scheme через light-dark(), тёмную включает класс .dark. При prefers-reduced-motion одно правило гасит transform, и карточка остаётся плоской.

ai.summary: Аватар-карточка с 3D-наклоном: портрет разворачивается в объёме за курсором или пальцем, слои разъезжаются параллаксом через translateZ, за указателем идёт блик. Имя и роль лежат поверх снимка на затемнении. Один файл, ноль зависимостей, собственная палитра.

en.title: Tilt Avatar
en.description: A portrait card that turns in 3D toward the cursor: the layers spread apart with parallax and a highlight follows the pointer. On touch it works by holding a finger.

en.docs: A client component: the tilt is computed from the cursor position inside the card and driven by CSS variables rx/ry rather than an inline transform. The layers — photo, scrim, glare, caption, badge — are spread over depth through translateZ on a shared scene with perspective and transform-style: preserve-3d, so they move apart with parallax on tilt. The pointermove stream is throttled through requestAnimationFrame: only the last position is applied per frame. The glare is a radial gradient in soft-light blend mode whose centre gx/gy follows the pointer and whose opacity drops on leave. The theme comes from color-scheme through light-dark(), and the .dark class turns the dark theme on. Under prefers-reduced-motion a single rule kills the transform and the card stays flat.

en.title: Gradient Icon Tile
en.docs: Server component, no hooks. Both ends of the gradient are derived from the --vibeui-icontile-002-hue variable: the second is taken by shifting 32° around the same oklch wheel, so the pair is always in tune and the tile can be recoloured with a single number. The inner light border is made with an inset shadow rather than a border: a border would eat into the tile size and knock the icon grid out of alignment. The size is set by data-size and one variable, from which the radius and the glyph size are computed. The tile is decorative: without a label it gets aria-hidden, with a label it gets role=img and an accessible name.

en.title: Surface Ring Stack
en.description: A stack whose ring matches the surface: the same group is shown on a light and a dark strip, making it obvious that the ring is the background, not a white border.
en.docs: A server component, no hooks. The ring colour is exposed through the --vibeui-iconstack-005-ring variable and set on the strip rather than on the circle: the dark strip overrides it with its own background, while the light strip takes the value from the ring prop and paints its own fill with it. Because of that the ring physically cannot drift away from the surface. Both strips are shown at once so that the difference reads without switching the theme. The overlap is built with a reversed flex row, and the circle hue is derived from the name with a hash. There is no outer surface by default: the body follows the surrounding color-scheme through light-dark(), while both strips deliberately keep fixed tones — that is what the demonstration rests on.
